description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
vibe: Skills are mandatory, personas don't talk to each other, and the user is always the orchestrator.
highlights: Skill-first execution model: if a task matches a skill, you MUST invoke it — never implement directly.
Anti-rationalization rules explicitly forbid 'this is too small for a skill' and 'I'll just quickly implement this'.
Strict separation of concerns: skills = how, personas = who, slash commands = when.
Personas cannot invoke other personas; only parallel fan-out with a merge step is endorsed.
Single source of truth principle: link to docs/skill-anatomy.md and CONTRIBUTING.md instead of restating guidance.
assessment: This file demonstrates mature systems thinking by treating agent behavior as an orchestration problem with explicit layers, lifecycle phases, and anti-patterns. The anti-rationalization section is particularly effective because it preempts the most common failure mode of LLM agents — skipping process for perceived simplicity. By enforcing a single source of truth and forbidding persona-to-persona calls, it prevents the combinatorial explosion of agent interactions that plagues naive multi-agent setups.
